skill.name: altllm-portal-cli
skill.description: Navigate AltLLM Portal CLI workflows across wallet authentication, API key lifecycle, billing, payment links, and x402 credit top-ups.
skill.summary: Maps multi-domain AltLLM Portal CLI workflows to focused skills.

security_audit.summary: All 15 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting and documentation paths. The reviewed files contain workflow guidance and command mappings, not executable shell code, path handling, reconnaissance, prompt injection, or data-exfiltration instructions.

content.value_statement: Portal tasks can cross authentication, API keys, billing, and payment workflows. This skill maps each task to focused local guidance for safer, consistent CLI use.
actual_capabilities: Distinguishes Portal API workflows from gateway model inference.
Routes authentication tasks to wallet login and session guidance.
Routes API key lifecycle tasks to focused key-management guidance.
Routes balance, transaction, promotion, and usage requests to billing guidance.
Routes crypto payment-link and x402 credit-top-up requests to focused guidance.
Lists supported subscription tiers and Flex model allowlist context.
limitations: Does not execute Portal CLI commands or modify accounts by itself.
Does not document gateway inference requests or proxy model traffic.
Requires focused skills for detailed command arguments and safeguards.
Portal access, payment availability, and model access depend on backend authorization.

use_cases.title: Coordinate account setup
use_cases.description: Plan wallet login, API key creation, and gateway verification in correct order.

use_cases.title: Investigate account usage
use_cases.description: Route balance, transaction, promotion, and model usage questions to billing guidance.

use_cases.title: Plan a credit top-up
use_cases.description: Select payment-link or x402 guidance before completing an authorized credit top-up.

prompt_templates.title: Find right workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to use AltLLM Portal CLI. Which focused skill should I read first?

prompt_templates.title: Set up access
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through wallet login, creating an API key, and verifying intended gateway use. Identify the focused skill for each step.

prompt_templates.title: Review billing
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to inspect credit, transactions, and usage by model. Map this request to the correct AltLLM Portal CLI guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Choose top-up path
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare authorized payment-link and x402 credit top-up workflows. List required confirmations before any payment action.

output_examples.input: I need to create and later revoke an API key.
output: Review creation, inspection, allowlist, and revocation guidance before acting.

output_examples.input: I need to review billing history and usage.
output: Review credit, transactions, usage summary, usage timeline, and usage-by-model guidance.

output_examples.input: I want to top up Portal credit.
output: Use altllm-portal-payments for payment links or altllm-x402 for x402 guidance.
Confirm wallet, amount, network, and payment status before completing payment.

best_practices: Read shared preflight and session guidance before first Portal CLI use.
Use focused skills for single-domain tasks and this skill for cross-domain planning.
Confirm account, wallet, target environment, and payment details before state-changing actions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat Portal API keys as interchangeable with gateway requests without verifying intended use.
Do not use payment guidance to authorize transfers without reviewing required confirmations.
Do not assume Flex model access without checking returned Portal metadata and backend authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It coordinates local AltLLM Portal CLI guidance across authentication, keys, billing, payments, and x402 top-ups.

faq.question: Does it run CLI commands?
faq.answer: No. It maps requests to focused skills and documents workflow boundaries.

faq.question: When should I use a focused skill?
faq.answer: Use one when your request stays within authentication, API keys, billing, payments, or x402.

faq.question: Does this skill handle model inference?
faq.answer: No. It covers Portal management workflows, not OpenAI-compatible gateway inference.

faq.question: Can it create a payment automatically?
faq.answer: No. Payment actions require authorized use of focused workflow guidance and confirmation.

faq.question: How do I check Flex access?
faq.answer: Use credit guidance to inspect returned subscription and model-access metadata, then respect backend checks.
